zh-CN.name: Taste Skill
zh-CN.shortDesc: 面向 AI Agent 的“抗平庸”前端美术指导：从 247 个精选网站研究中抽取设计方向，执行无装饰的统一风格，并在真实浏览器中检查网页与应用界面。需 Node.js 22+ 与本地 Chrome/Edge/Chromium；图片检索调用公开馆藏接口，生成页面可能加载第三方字体、图片与脚本。

en-US.name: Taste Skill
en-US.shortDesc: Anti-slop art direction for AI agents building websites and app screens: deals researched directions from a 247-site study, enforces a no-ornament house style and checks pages in a real browser. Needs Node.js 22+ and a local Chrome/Edge/Chromium; picture search uses public open-collection APIs, and generated pages may load third-party fonts, photos and scripts.
